cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(windows_null_rejection LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT WIN32)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "This test exercises the Windows playback path")
endif()
add_executable(windows_null_rejection windows_null_rejection.cc ../../src/mp_audio_stream.cc)
target_compile_features(windows_null_rejection PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(windows_null_rejection PRIVATE MA_ENABLE_ONLY_SPECIFIC_BACKENDS MA_ENABLE_NULL)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME windows_null_rejection COMMAND windows_null_rejection)
